caption: The drawing features several geometric and symbolic objects arranged vertically on a textured, parchment-colored background. At the top of the composition is a stylized cross with curved edges, rendered in a muted yellow with a rusty red outline and filled with blue accents inside its arms. Just below the cross is a bow-shaped element also in yellow, outlined in blue and decorated with small red dots and a central circle containing a star-like pattern. Flanking this bow on either side are two stylized wings in the same muted yellow, each tipped with red triangular accents. At the bottom of the composition is a large, circular medallion, outlined in red and blue, and filled with symmetrical, sunburst and petal-shaped patterns in yellow, red, and blue. The overall color scheme is dominated by muted yellow, rusty red, and blue, with the background giving an aged, vintage appearance.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
